pairsWith.noteUz: O'zlik olmoshlari coursebook 71-bet 8-mashqqa; had to/didn't have to, could/couldn't coursebook 73-betga; So do I / Neither do I coursebook 15-bet qoidasi va 73-bet muloqotiga mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 10-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (44-bet). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '10' va 'Stick to the Rules!'.

CHAP USTUN:
(7-mashq davomi) 5 (mashina taqiqlangan belgi) '... I drive in the city centre? (use/bus service)' A: ...... B: ......
8) 'Complete each short exchange by filling in the correct reflexive pronoun.' 1 A: I fell off my bike yesterday. B: Did you hurt ......? 2 A: Is the water hot? B: Yes, I scalded ...... . 3 A: Shall I help you? B: No, I can do it ...... . 4 A: He has broken a glass. B: Did he cut ......? 5 A: Where did you buy that lovely dress? B: I made it ...... . 6 A: Did George take his car to the garage? B: No, he fixed it ...... . 7 A: The Robinsons have got a very nice house. B: Yes, they painted it ...... . 8 A: That cake is delicious. B: My mother made it ...... .
9) 'Look at the list of things Mark and Julie had to do. Write sentences about what each of them had to and didn't have to do for the picnic, as in the example.' JADVAL THINGS TO DO / MARK / JULIE: 1 Go to the supermarket ✓ ✗; 2 Make the sandwiches ✓ ✗; 3 Buy a film for the camera ✗ ✓; 4 Wash the picnic blanket ✗ ✓; 5 Bring a football ✓ ✗. 1 ...Mark had to go to the supermarket. Julie didn't have to go to the supermarket.... 2-5 bo'sh.

O'NG USTUN:
10) 'Use the prompts below to write a short paragraph about what you could and couldn't do when you were five.' • sing • swim • dance • play tennis • read • play a musical instrument • use a computer • ride a bike • speak English. 'When I was five ......'
• 'Communication: Positive/Negative Agreement'.
11) 'Look at the pictures below, then use the prompts to make short dialogues, as in the example.' 1 (maktabga qo'l ko'targan bola; pianino chalayotgan qiz): go to school / go to my piano lesson. A: I have to go to school tomorrow. B: So do I, but I don't have to go to my piano lesson. A: Neither do I. 2 (xat tashlayotgan erkak; telefon hisobidan terlagan erkak): post a letter / pay the phone bill. 3 (itni cho'mintirish; gul sug'orayotgan qiz): give the dog a bath / water the plants.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '44'.

exercises.instructionEn: (Ex. 7 continued) 5 (no cars sign) ... I drive in the city centre? (use/bus service)
exercises.instructionUz: (7-mashq davomi) 5 (mashina taqiqlangan belgi) ... I drive in the city centre? (use/bus service)
exercises.explanationUz:
BE ALLOWED TO - 5-band.
  'No cars' belgisi → shahar
  markazida mashina haydash taqiq,
  avtobus xizmatidan foydalanish
  mumkin.


⚠ 'A BUS SERVICE':

  = avtobus xizmati (qatnovi).

items.question: Can I drive in the city centre?
items.answer: No, you aren't allowed to drive in the city centre, but you can use the bus service.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'aren't allowed to drive' + 'can use the bus service'.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete each short exchange by filling in the correct reflexive pronoun.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir qisqa suhbatni to'g'ri o'zlik olmoshi bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ZLIK OLMOShLARI (coursebook
  71-bet qoida-o'zlik).

  IKKI VAZIFA:
  1) Ega = to'ldiruvchi:
     'hurt yourself', 'scalded
     myself', 'cut himself'
  2) 'O'ZI' (urg'u - yordamsiz):
     'I can do it MYSELF', 'I made
     it MYSELF', 'he fixed it
     HIMSELF', 'they painted it
     THEMSELVES', 'my mother made
     it HERSELF'

  1 you → yourself
  2 I → myself
  3 I → myself
  4 he → himself
  5 I → myself
  6 he → himself
  7 they → themselves
  8 my mother → herself


⚠ 'THE ROBINSONS':

  = Robinsonlar oilasi → they.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the list of things Mark and Julie had to do. Write sentences about what each of them had to and didn't have to do for the picnic, as in the example. 1 Go to the supermarket: Mark ✓ Julie ✗ 2 Make the sandwiches: Mark ✓ Julie ✗ 3 Buy a film for the camera: Mark ✗ Julie ✓ 4 Wash the picnic blanket: Mark ✗ Julie ✓ 5 Bring a football: Mark ✓ Julie ✗
exercises.instructionUz: Mark va Juli qilishi kerak bo'lgan ishlar ro'yxatiga qarang. Piknik uchun har biri nima qilishi kerak va shart emas bo'lgani haqida gaplar yozing, namunadagidek. 1 Supermarketga borish: Mark ✓ Juli ✗ 2 Sendvich tayyorlash: Mark ✓ Juli ✗ 3 Fotoapparat uchun plyonka olish: Mark ✗ Juli ✓ 4 Piknik adyolini yuvish: Mark ✗ Juli ✓ 5 Futbol to'pi olib kelish: Mark ✓ Juli ✗
exercises.explanationUz:
HAD TO / DIDN'T HAVE TO - O'TGAN
  ZAMON MAJBURIYATI.

  had to = qilishi kerak edi (✓)
  didn't have to = qilishi shart
  emas edi (✗)

  ⚠ 'must' ning o'tgan zamoni YO'Q
  → 'had to' ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'A FILM FOR THE CAMERA':

  = fotoapparat plyonkasi (1999 -
  raqamli emas!).


⚠ 'A PICNIC BLANKET':

  = piknik adyoli.
exercises.exampleEn: Mark had to go to the supermarket. Julie didn't have to go to the supermarket.
exercises.exampleUz: Mark supermarketga borishi kerak edi. Juli supermarketga borishi shart emas edi.
modelAnswers: Mark had to make the sandwiches. Julie didn't have to make the sandwiches.
Mark didn't have to buy a film for the camera. Julie had to buy a film for the camera.
Mark didn't have to wash the picnic blanket. Julie had to wash the picnic blanket.
Mark had to bring a football. Julie didn't have to bring a football.
modelAnswersUz: Mark sendvich tayyorlashi kerak edi. Juli sendvich tayyorlashi shart emas edi.
Mark fotoapparat uchun plyonka olishi shart emas edi. Juli plyonka olishi kerak edi.
Mark piknik adyolini yuvishi shart emas edi. Juli adyolni yuvishi kerak edi.
Mark futbol to'pi olib kelishi kerak edi. Juli to'p olib kelishi shart emas edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts below to write a short paragraph about what you could and couldn't do when you were five: sing, swim, dance, play tennis, read, play a musical instrument, use a computer, ride a bike, speak English. Start: When I was five ...
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan besh yoshingizda nima qila olganingiz va qila olmaganingiz haqida qisqa xatboshi yozing: sing, swim, dance, play tennis, read, play a musical instrument, use a computer, ride a bike, speak English. Boshlanishi: When I was five ...
exercises.explanationUz:
COULD / COULDN'T - O'TGAN ZAMON
  QOBILIYATI.

  could = qila olardim
  couldn't = qila olmasdim

  ⚠ 'can' ning o'tgan zamoni =
  'could'.
  ⚠ 'could' dan keyin fe'l ODDIY
  ShAKLDA.


QOLIP:
  When I was five, I could ... and
  ..., but I couldn't ... or ... .

  ⚠ Inkorda 'or': 'I couldn't play
  tennis OR speak English'.

structure.modelEn: When I was five, I could sing and dance. I could also ride a bike and I could read a little.
structure.modelUz: Besh yoshimda men qo'shiq aytib, raqsga tusha olardim. Velosiped ham hayday olardim va biroz o'qiy olardim.

structure.modelEn: However, I couldn't swim or play tennis. I couldn't play a musical instrument, use a computer or speak English.
structure.modelUz: Ammo suza olmasdim va tennis o'ynay olmasdim. Cholg'u asbobi chala olmasdim, kompyuter ishlata olmasdim va inglizcha gapira olmasdim.

modelAnswers: When I was five, I could sing and dance. I could also ride a bike and I could read a little. However, I couldn't swim or play tennis. I couldn't play a musical instrument, use a computer or speak English. Now I can do all of these things!
modelAnswersUz: Besh yoshimda men qo'shiq aytib, raqsga tusha olardim. Velosiped ham hayday olardim va biroz o'qiy olardim. Ammo suza olmasdim va tennis o'ynay olmasdim. Cholg'u asbobi chala olmasdim, kompyuter ishlata olmasdim va inglizcha gapira olmasdim. Endi bularning hammasini qila olaman!

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures below, then use the prompts to make short dialogues, as in the example. 1 go to school / go to my piano lesson 2 post a letter / pay the phone bill 3 give the dog a bath / water the plants. Example: A: I have to go to school tomorrow. B: So do I, but I don't have to go to my piano lesson. A: Neither do I.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmlarga qarang, so'ng ko'rsatmalar bilan qisqa dialoglar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 go to school / go to my piano lesson 2 post a letter / pay the phone bill 3 give the dog a bath / water the plants. Namuna: A: Ertaga maktabga borishim kerak. B: Men ham, lekin pianino darsiga borishim shart emas. A: Men ham.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO DO I / NEITHER DO I - 'HAVE
  TO' BILAN (11-betdagi 14-mashqni
  eslang).

  'I HAVE to ...' → 'SO do I'
    (tasdiqqa rozilik)
  'I DON'T have to ...' → 'NEITHER
    do I' (inkorga rozilik)

  ⚠ 'have to' oddiy fe'l kabi →
  yordamchi 'do'.


⚠ 'TO POST A LETTER':

  = xat jo'natmoq.


⚠ 'TO PAY THE PHONE BILL':

  = telefon hisobini to'lamoq.

items.prompt: go to school / go to my piano lesson
items.question: I have to go to school tomorrow. - So do I, but I don't have to go to my piano lesson.

items.prompt: post a letter / pay the phone bill
items.question: I have to post a letter tomorrow. - So do I, but I don't have to pay the phone bill.

items.prompt: give the dog a bath / water the plants
items.question: I have to give the dog a bath tomorrow. - So do I, but I don't have to water the plants.

sentencePatterns.introUz: O'zlik olmoshlari, had to, could, rozilik.

patterns.formula: I did it myself. / He fixed it himself.
X had to + FE'L. Y didn't have to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Mark had to go to the supermarket. Julie didn't have to.
patterns.exampleUz: Mark supermarketga borishi kerak edi. Juli borishi shart emas edi.

patterns.formula: When I was five, I could ..., but I couldn't ...
patterns.exampleEn: When I was five, I could sing, but I couldn't swim.
patterns.exampleUz: Besh yoshimda qo'shiq ayta olardim, lekin suza olmasdim.

patterns.formula: I have to ... - So do I. / I don't have to ... - Neither do I.
patterns.exampleEn: I don't have to go to my piano lesson. - Neither do I.
patterns.exampleUz: Pianino darsiga borishim shart emas. - Men ham.
